standard-dialogue-before-completion-of-m.text: Daero seems like he is enjoying himself too much to talk.

options.text: I want to sign up for the training programme.

steps.npc: Hello there. I hear your mission is complete.

steps.player: News travels quickly on this tree. I expect you also know that I am to be enrolled in the Royal Guard training programme.

steps.npc: For you, it should hardly take any time at all.
Enthusiasm. I like that. We will first begin with a series of exercises designed to increase your strength and stamina.
We then will follow these up by improving your attack and defence techniques.
You will improve your strength, stamina, attack and defence, but you may choose what you want to focus on.

options.text: Focus on increasing strength and stamina...
Focus on improving attack and defence techniques...
I need to return to Crash Island.

steps.player: I need to return to Crash Island.

steps.text: You wear the blindfold Daero hands you.
The screen fades to black and the player is taken to the secret hangar.

standard-dialogue-after-completion-of-mo.npc: Speak to Waydar when you are ready to leave.
